sources: MI Security 3-piece (EquipSuitTable suit_criti01): rmxlinux SkillData passive_equipsuit_critsuit_01 (Crit Rate + crit_up, on the stat panel) → BuffData buff_equipsuit_critsuit_01: on abilityEvent 44 (the wearer scores a critical hit) → CreateBuff buff_equipsuit_critsuitatk_01 (attr 2 formulaItem 6: ATK + atk_up per layer, `duration` 5 s, stackingType 8 max max_stack 5: layers on one timer each new layer refreshes; the loader sets sharedTimer from it). critsuitatk's buffEvent 6 (a layer change) with CheckBuffStackNum ≥ max_stack → CreateBuff buff_equipsuit_critsuitdmg_01 (Crit Rate + crit_up2, lifeType 1: until ended); its buffEvent 2 (its end) → FinishBuff critsuitdmg.

Description: "After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK +{atk_up} for {duration}s. This effect can reach {max_stack} stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate +{crit_up2}. This effect cannot stack." The max-stacks check reads the ATK buff's own layers (buffLayers). Crits are only events with rolled crits (scenario crit "rolled"; design.md, Damage): with expected crits the set gives only its Crit Rate.

buffs.label: MI Security: Crit Rate at max layers
